headline: V34: Superpowers Discipline Layer for strict clarification, planning, TDD, and verification
highlights: Superpowers V34 Discipline: Agents must clarify requirements, use no placeholders in planning, apply RED-GREEN-REFACTOR, debug root causes, and verify before claiming completion.
Validator Script: validate_superpowers_discipline.py enforces V34 markers across workflows, templates, and specs.
Integrated Gates: Preflight, postflight, docs gates, and execution readiness now run the V34 discipline validator as a hard requirement.
Updated Templates: Spec, plan, tasks, verification, and execution-brief templates all contain explicit V34 discipline and clarification ledgers.
Updated Workflows: All major slash commands (develop, planning, design, quick_fix, etc.) embed V34 operating rules directly.
post_update_steps: Run /init_brain after /update_brain to reload rules, MCP registration, skill routing, and the V34 command surface.
Run `python3 .agents/scripts/validate_superpowers_discipline.py --root .` to ensure V34 compliance in your workflows.
Run `python3 .agents/scripts/validate_command_surface.py --root .` after merging/updating `.agents` to confirm command contracts stayed aligned.
Check your project's active `spec.md` and `plan.md` against the new V34 markers if execution readiness fails.
Use /marcus.clarify to resolve blocking ambiguity before moving to /marcus.plan.
onboarding_prompts: Read `V34.0_RELEASE_NOTES.md` for the full overview of the Superpowers discipline rollout.
Always clarify requirements before planning: do not invent assumptions if intent, scope, or platform constraints are unclear.
Ensure tasks follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR and NO COMPLETION CLAIMS are made without concrete verification.
Review `SLASH_COMMAND_REGISTRY.md` to see the updated commands and their strict V34 validation gates.
